name: lookup_postcode
description: Get geographic details for a UK postcode (e.g., 'SW1A 1AA'). Returns coordinates, region, district, ward, and constituency.

postcode.description: UK postcode to look up (e.g. "SW1A 1AA" or "SW1A1AA").

name: nearest_postcodes
description: Find nearby UK postcodes sorted by distance from a given postcode (e.g., 'SW1A 1AA'). Returns list with coordinates.

postcode.description: UK postcode to find neighbours for (e.g. "SW1A 1AA").

name: validate_postcode
description: Validate a UK postcode format (e.g., 'SW1A 1AA'). Returns whether it's valid and format details.

name: random_postcode
description: Get a random valid UK postcode with full geographic details. Returns coordinates, region, district, ward, and constituency.
